name: io.github.baronsigma/factrail
title: Factrail
description: Evidence infrastructure for AI agents: structured verification, import assessment, and retrievable receipts.

remotes.description: Production MCP server with company verification, import assessment, and company analysis

tools.name: factrail_verify
tools.description: Establish evidence-backed facts about a supported subject. Supports French companies by SIREN or SIRET; returns facts, provenance, coverage, and a receipt.

subject_type.description: Currently only French companies are supported.

fields.description: Optional company fields to resolve; omit for the default set.

tools.name: factrail_assess
tools.description: Perform an evidence-backed structured assessment. Supports import scenarios and returns an EvidenceEnvelope with source coverage and a receipt.

tools.name: factrail_get_receipt
tools.description: Retrieve the immutable EvidenceEnvelope associated with a FACTRAIL receipt ID.

tools.name: verify_french_company
tools.description: Verify a French company by SIREN (9-digit) or SIRET (14-digit). Returns structured verified data from INSEE Sirene (official company register) with BODACC company-event intelligence (legal notices, proceedings, filings). Legacy response shape; use factrail_verify for an EvidenceEnvelope.

tools.name: assess_import
tools.description: Legacy EU import assessment response with classification, duty, VAT, compliance, landed cost, and missing inputs. Use factrail_assess for an EvidenceEnvelope. Results are indicative and are not binding customs rulings.

product.description: Short product description (e.g. '750ml insulated stainless steel drinking bottle').

destination_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 EU destination country code (e.g. 'FR'). V0 supports EU member states only.

goods_value.description: Total goods value in the given currency.

known_hs_code.description: Optional known HS code (6-10 digits). If supplied, validated and enriched.

weight_kg.description: Optional gross weight per unit in kg.

freight_cost.description: Optional total freight cost in the given currency.

insurance_cost.description: Optional total insurance cost in the given currency.

tools.name: analyze_company
tools.description: Legacy experimental company analysis. Financial and credit figures are placeholders, not verified risk assessments.
